description: This PHP file is a controller class for managing currency tasks within the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods to generate task lists, create currency JSON files, and clear currency JSON files for different stores and languages.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for handling currency-related administrative tasks in OpenCart, including task creation, listing, and clearing currency data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tasks related to currency management, such as clearing old data and scheduling currency list updates for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON file of currencies for a specified store and language, used for generating currency lists for frontend display.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing currency JSON files for all stores and languages to reset currency data.
